$comment: Adjudicated PRE-EXISTING sites for db/gates/check-call-site-param-contracts.mjs.
Read this before adding an entry: NOTHING HERE IS AN APPROVED SHAPE. Every
entry is a real mismatch -- a call passing an object key its callee does not
accept, so the callee silently uses its default. They are recorded because
the gate landed on a tree that already carried them, and a gate red on
standing debt makes master red and defers every session push. The gate is a
ratchet: it fails on anything NEW.
Every entry is keyed on a SITE -- (caller, callee, key) -- and NEVER on the
argument key alone. A name-keyed entry would suppress that key at every
caller in the tree, which is the same stoplist failure that hid
scoring_format_player_projection_points.total from check-renamed-column-consumers.
The LINE is deliberately not part of the key. Lane 1 shifted three findings
in finalize-game.mjs by fourteen lines without changing anything about them,
and an entry that goes stale on an unrelated edit above it teaches people to
regenerate this file wholesale rather than read it.
An entry that suppresses nothing is reported as a STALE ADJUDICATION and
fails the gate, so a repaired site forces its entry out rather than leaving a
standing exemption. Removing an entry is the LAST step of a repair, in the
same commit.
verdict = pre-existing-defect   a real mismatch predating this gate. The
reason must name where the repair is tracked.
